headline: Banking, clearly organized.
body: See accounts, move money, and work within clear role boundaries from one calm banking experience.
previewLabel: An anonymized preview of the banking account overview
accountsBody: Understand balances and activity with clear account-level views.
transfersBody: Move funds between eligible accounts through focused workflows.
accessBody: Each customer and staff role sees the tools and data assigned to it.
securityTitle: Access is enforced by the banking API.
securityBody: The interface reflects the application’s real authorization boundaries—without making regulatory or production claims.
roleAccessBody: Customer, teller, manager, auditor, and administrator permissions are evaluated for each operation.
isolationBody: Customer account and transaction requests are scoped to the authenticated owner.
auditBody: Deposits, withdrawals, transfers, and access changes retain traceable records.
rolesTitle: A focused starting point for every role.
rolesBody: The dashboard changes with the job to be done, while authorization remains on the server.

roleDescriptions.CUSTOMER: Balances, owned accounts, activity, and transfers.
roleDescriptions.TELLER: Customer service, account lookup, and personal operation history.
roleDescriptions.MANAGER: Bank position, money movement, and operational oversight.
roleDescriptions.AUDITOR: Read-only activity tracing and operator visibility.
roleDescriptions.ADMIN: Identity health, role distribution, and access changes.

demoBody: Use synthetic identities to explore customer and staff experiences. Credentials live in the public documentation, never inline here.
demoNoProduction: No production or real customer data
footer: An educational banking application. Not a production bank or regulated financial institution.
